description: We are a team of six students working on Solar Weather Explorer, an educational app designed to help students learn about solar activity and space weather. The app will include easy-to-understand explanations of science concepts, learning activities and quizzes to help students test their knowledge. We are all beginners, but we are excited to learn new things, explore space science and work together to develop our project.
summary:
Astria is an educational application designed to introduce young learners and beginners to space science through simple explanations and interactive quizzes. It covers five key areas: the Sun, solar flares, Jupiter, the Moon and NASA data. Users can explore each topic, learn basic scientific information and then test their understanding through a short quiz containing three questions, with scores awarded for correct answers.

Astria addresses the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge by providing an accessible starting point for young learners to build their knowledge of space and develop an interest in space exploration. By combining short learning sessions with quizzes, the application encourages curiosity, active learning and knowledge retention. It makes basic space science easier to approach, especially for those with little or no previous knowledge of astronomy.
details:
Astria is an educational app that helps young learners and beginners explore space through simple lessons and interactive quizzes. It covers five topics: the Sun, solar flares, Jupiter, the Moon and NASA data. Users can select a topic, read basic information and answer a three-question quiz based on what they have learned.

The app aims to make space science more accessible, encourage curiosity and improve learning through active participation. Its creative approach is the combination of short, topic-based lessons and quizzes in one simple platform, allowing users to learn and test their knowledge at their own pace.

While developing the app, our team focused on simplicity, ease of navigation, beginner-friendly content and an engaging learning experience. We developed it using MIT App Inventor, a beginner-friendly app development platform. We also used ChatGPT for guidance and assistance with ideas and Google for research. Our team used the platform's interface and visual programming blocks to design the app and connect its different functions.

Astria aims to inspire young learners to develop an interest in astronomy and space exploration.
